mapper.select: select bpl.id, bpl.user_id, su.nickname as name , sd.name as deptName, bpl.points, bpl.before_points, bpl.after_points, bpl.remark, bpl.type, bpl.status, bpl.invalid_time, bpl.create_time, bpl.create_user from biz_points_log bpl left join sys_user su on bpl.user_id = su.id left join sys_dept sd on su.dept_id = sd.id ${ew.customSqlSegment} order by bpl.create_time desc
